_readme: Breathing presets. 'seconds' is [inhale, hold, exhale, hold] — a 0 means that phase is skipped, which is how 4-7-8 (no second hold) and coherent breathing (no holds at all) reuse the same four-number shape instead of needing a special case. The app's steppers can override any of these; only the last-used seconds are remembered on the device, not which preset they came from.

presets.name: Box breathing
presets.desc: Equal 4-count square. Tactical/Navy SEAL "combat breathing" used to stay calm under acute stress.
Dr. Andrew Weil's technique: one hold, then a long exhale, to settle anxiety or ease into sleep.

presets.name: Coherent
presets.desc: No holds — smooth pacing at ~5 breaths/min, the resonance rate shown to maximise heart-rate variability.

presets.name: Pursed-lip
presets.desc: Short nasal inhale, exhale twice as long through pursed lips. Standard technique to ease breathlessness.
